data.name: Laina
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Laina is the name of a nymph who personified the gentle flow of rivers. The name is derived from the Greek word 'leinan', meaning 'to flow'. In Christianity, Laina is also associated with the Virgin Mary, whose maternal love flows endlessly.
